<?php $e=new Exception("x");class O{function __toString(){global $e;throw $e;}}function f():string{global $e;try{return new O;}catch(Exception $x){echo "BAD;";}catch(TypeError $x){echo $x->getPrevious()===$e?"P;":"N;";return "caught";}}echo f();
<?php class O{function __toString(){echo "T;";throw new Exception("x");}}function f():string{try{return new O;}finally{echo "F;";}}try{f();}catch(TypeError $e){echo get_class($e->getPrevious());}

<?php $e=new Exception("x");class C{function __toString(){global $e;throw $e;}}class B{function __toString(){return new C;}}class A{function __toString(){return new B;}}function f():string{return new A;}try{f();}catch(TypeError $x){echo get_class($x),get_class($x->getPrevious()),get_class($x->getPrevious()->getPrevious()),$x->getPrevious()->getPrevious()->getPrevious()===$e?"P":"N";}

<?php class E extends Exception{} class O{function __toString(){throw new E("x");}} function f():string{return new O;} try{f();}catch(TypeError $x){echo get_class($x->getPrevious()),":",$x->getPrevious() instanceof E?"yes":"no";}

<?php class E extends Exception{}try{try{throw new E("old");}finally{throw new Exception("new");}}catch(Throwable $e){echo get_class($e),":",get_class($e->getPrevious()),":",$e->getPrevious() instanceof E?"yes":"no";}
